title: ICGV 96176 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: ICGV 96176 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: ICGV 96176 peanut is a peanut variety for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao. 105 to 107 days to harvest, 1.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: ICGV 96176 is a registered peanut variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2015 as NSIC 2015 Pn 19. It takes 105 to 107 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.9 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 105 to 107 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 1.9 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

ICGV 96176 peanut takes 105 to 107 days from sowing to harvest. That is 4.7 days longer than the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.9 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.85. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 57.7 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed holds 25.4 percent crude protein.
Where and when to plant ICGV 96176 peanut

It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao. Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.
